{{Header Nav|game=The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time}}
{{floatingtoc}}
{{Control selector|Nintendo 64, GameCube, Wii (classic), Nintendo 3DS, Nintendo Switch}}

There are many '''songs''' that you can play on the {{im/oot|Items|Ocarina of Time}}. Some of these are needed to complete the game, but it is possible to play other songs as well.

[[File:OoT Learning Song of Time.jpg|thumb|left|Link plays the Song of Time.]]
{{-}}

== Playing Songs ==
To play Ocarina songs, press the C button it is equipped to. 

For the GameCube controller, you can use the {{gc|neutral|cstick}} and/or {{gc|X}}, {{gc|Y}}, {{gc|z}} to select the items. 

The Wii Classic Controller uses the {{wii-cc|neutral|rstick}}, {{wii-cc|x}}, {{wii-cc|y}} and/or {{wii-cc|zl}}/{{wii-cc|zr}} to select an item. 

On the Nintendo 3DS, there is a button on the Touch Screen {{ds|Stylus}} for the Ocarina.

On the Nintendo Switch, you can use the {{Switch|neutral|rstick}}, {{Switch|x}}, {{Switch|y}} and/or {{Switch|ZR}}{{plus}}{{Switch|a}} to select an item.


;The rest of the content on this page is displayed depending on the controller setting chosen at the top of this page
Use {{control|{{N64|A}}|{{gc|a}}|{{wii-cc|a}}|{{3ds|A}}|{{Switch|A}}}} and {{control|{{N64|Left|C}} {{N64|Up|C}} {{N64|Right|C}} {{N64|Down|C}}|{{gc|left|cstick}}({{gc|y}}) {{gc|up|cstick}} {{gc|right|cstick}}({{gc|x}}) {{gc|down|cstick}}({{gc|z}})|{{wii-cc|left|rstick}}({{wii-cc|y}}) {{wii-cc|up|rstick}} {{wii-cc|right|rstick}}({{wii-cc|x}}) {{wii-cc|down|rstick}} ({{wii-cc|zl}}/{{wii-cc|zr}})|{{3ds|L}}{{3ds|Y}}{{3ds|X}}{{3ds|R}}|{{Switch|left|rstick}}({{Switch|y}}) {{Switch|up|rstick}}({{Switch|ZR}}{{plus}}{{Switch|x}}) {{Switch|right|rstick}}({{Switch|ZR}}{{plus}}{{Switch|a}}) {{Switch|down|rstick}}({{Switch|x}})}} to play notes. 

Holding {{control|{{N64|R}}|{{gc|r}}|{{wii-cc|r}}|{{3ds|Up|Dpad}}|{{Switch|R}}}} makes the note sharp, and holding {{control|{{N64|Z}}|{{gc|l}}|{{wii-cc|l}}|{{3ds|Down|Dpad}}|{{Switch|ZL}}}} makes the note flat. {{control|{{N64|Up|Control}}|{{gc|up|control}}|{{wii-cc|up|lstick}}|{{3ds|Up|Cpad}}|{{Switch|Up|lstick}}}} gradually raises the note to its next higher note, and {{control|{{N64|Down|Control}}|{{gc|down|control}}|{{wii-cc|down|lstick}}|{{3ds|Down|Cpad}}|{{Switch|down|lstick}}}} dips it to the next lower one. {{control|{{N64|Left|Control}}|{{gc|left|control}}|{{wii-cc|left|lstick}}|{{3ds|Left|Dpad}}|{{Switch|left|lstick}}}} or {{control|{{N64|Right|Control}}|{{gc|right|control}}|{{wii-cc|right|lstick}}|{{3ds|Right|Dpad}}|{{Switch|Right|Lstick}}}} gives the note a vibrating effect.

== Song List ==
===Zelda's Lullaby===
Use any time you see the Triforce, the Royal Family Crest, or when you need to establish yourself as a messenger of the Royal Family. For example, when this song is played while standing on the Triforce-shaped crest in the Kakariko Graveyard, the Royal Tomb will open, allowing entry. Playing the tune in front of Darunia's room in Goron City will open the door into his room. Playing this song on the crest at the end of Zora's River will reveal the entrance to Zora's Domain behind the waterfall. In Great Fairy Fountains, play it on the Triforce symbol and a Great Fairy will appear. If you break a sign and play this song, the sign will be restored. Playing this song near Gossip Stones (one-eyed statues) causes rejuvenating fairies to appear.

[[File:OOT 1 Zelda's Lullaby.png]]

===Epona's Song===
Use in Hyrule Field to call Epona to your side (does not work as Young Link). Also, playing the song near a cow will earn you a bottle full of free milk (assuming you have an empty bottle).

[[File:OOT 2 Epona's Song.png]]

===Saria's Song===
Use anywhere to talk to Saria. Saria will give you a hint as to where you should proceed next.  For example, after obtaining the Goron Ruby from the Gorons, the only way of knowing to visit the Zoras for the Zora's Sapphire is to talk to Saria. Also used to cheer up the Goron Elder Darunia before entering the Dodongo's Cavern and to get Mido to let you through the Lost Woods as an adult.

[[File:OOT 3 Saria's song.png]]

===Sun's Song===
[[File:LOZ OOT Sun's Song.png|200px|right|thumb|Learning about the Sun's Song]]
Any time you can see the sky (ie., not in a dungeon), play this song to switch between day and night.  After playing this song, the game will proceed from either 12:00 noon or 12:00 midnight. This song also freezes ReDeads, but only temporarily. This song can also summon a fairy if Navi turns green.

[[File:OOT 4 Sun's Song.png]]

===Scarecrow's Song===
Causes a scarecrow to appear that can be helpful in your quest.

The notes of this song can be composed by you. Talk to the scarecrow at Lake Hylia and play a song eight notes long. This song can be changed at any time and it is the only song that will not be recorded with the others on the Quest Status screen.

== Frog mini game ==
As a child, you can play songs to the frogs in Zora's river for rewards (such as two pieces of heart). Please see [[../Minigames#Musical_Frogs|the Minigames page for more details]].

[[File:OoT Ocarina.jpg|thumb|The Ocarina of Time.]]
These are songs that don't have any effect in-game, but are fun to play when you want to wind down. (The '''+''' icon means that you must press these buttons simultaneously.)

===Full-length Saria's Song===
